exposure: On-demand analgesic protocol (paracetamol + ibuprofen as needed)
Scheduled analgesic protocol (paracetamol + ibuprofen every 6 hours)
outcome: Maternal satisfaction with labor and delivery experience
finding: While both scheduled and on-demand analgesic protocols resulted in similar pain scores after vaginal delivery, the scheduled protocol was associated with higher breastfeeding rates and increased maternal satisfaction.
mod_finding: This study found that a scheduled analgesic protocol for postpartum pain management following vaginal delivery resulted in similar pain scores compared with an on-demand protocol.
